name: Flirsch
kurzbeschreibung: Cozy village in the Stanzer Tal on the way to the Arlberg, featuring traditional architecture and a peaceful setting.
beschreibung:
Flirsch lies at 1,154 m above sea level in the front part of the Stanzer Tal, between Landeck and St. Anton am Arlberg, and is one of the quieter addresses at the foot of the famous Ski Arlberg. The market town has around 1,000 inhabitants, spread across a village that has retained its village character – without the hustle and bustle of the well-known tourism strongholds further up the valley.

Architecturally, Flirsch stands out for its late Baroque and Engadin-influenced houses, many of them with elaborate sgraffito façades and small oriel windows. The Parish Church of St. Bartholomew with its distinctive onion dome shapes the townscape. For active holidaymakers, Flirsch offers direct access to the Ski Arlberg Arena – one of the largest contiguous ski areas in Österreich with over 300 kilometres of pistes. In summer, hikes through the nearby Rosannaschlucht and tours toward Arlbergpass and Flexenpass are a draw. The location away from the main traffic artery provides exactly the tranquillity that families and peace-seekers appreciate.

Culinarily, regional classics are on the menu: Kasnocken, Schlutzkrapfen and Tiroler Gröstl are prepared authentically in the few inns. Anyone looking for genuine mountain village atmosphere and yet not wanting to miss out on access to a world-class ski circus will find in Flirsch a rare mix of unspoilt character and accessibility. 🏘️
